chronicle.worldbetween.neris.arrival: Fugitives stepped out of a Nether portal: former slaves of the Hellsmiths. They made camp %s at (%s, %s).
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_farm: The first field was ploughed in %s. The former slaves eat bread grown by their own hands.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_lumbe: The axes of the first lumber camp ring out in %s.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_quarr: The first quarry was opened in %s.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_mine: The first mine was dug in %s. The Neris are underground again, but by their own will.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_smelt: The first smelter was lit in %s. The fire that once burned them now serves them.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_forge: The first blade was forged in %s. The Hellsmiths taught them well.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.first_barra: The first barracks stand in %s. The Kingdom of Neris is raising an army.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.famine: Famine in %s. People are dying of hunger.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.tier_1: The camp of %s has grown into a settlement.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.tier_2: %s has been walled and is now a fort.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.era_1: The Kingdom of Neris has entered the Bronze Age.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.era_2: The Kingdom of Neris has entered the Iron Age. Their guards now wear iron.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.era_3: The Kingdom of Neris has entered the Steel Age. Their army is a power everyone must reckon with.
command.worldbetween.status.not_arrived: has not come to this world yet
bossbar.worldbetween.guards: Guards of %s are coming: leave the mine
message.worldbetween.noticed.trespass: The miners have noticed a stranger. Guards of %s are setting out from the shaft. You have about %s min. to leave.
message.worldbetween.noticed.theft: The miners saw you take what isn't yours! Guards of %s are setting out from the shaft. You have about %s min. to leave.
message.worldbetween.noticed.vandalism: You are breaking someone's mine! Guards of %s are coming from the shaft. You have about %s min. to leave.
message.worldbetween.left: You left the mine. The guards of %s return to their post.
message.worldbetween.criminal: You did not leave in time. %s declares you a criminal.
message.worldbetween.theft: This is the property of %s. Taking it is theft.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.criminal: A stranger named %s would not leave the mine of %s and was declared a criminal of the kingdom.
chronicle.worldbetween.neris.mine_level_: The miners of %s have opened a second level. Picks ring underground: the kingdom is after gold.
The mines of %s have reached the depths. Down by the lava channels, underground forges are lit.

command.worldbetween.mine.progress: Dug: %s of %s for today, %s steps in the plan, %s sections
